Class Cannon

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.tiles.Tile
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.tiles.Cannon
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable
Direct Known Subclasses:
DoubleCannon, SingleCannon
public abstract class Cannon extends Tile
Abstract class representing a generic cannon tile on a ship. A cannon has a direction in which it fires and must not face another tile. Specific cannon types (e.g., single, double) extend this class.
